html:
The Emirate of Nejd and Hasa was the state that Ibn Saud built in central Arabia after he retook Riyadh in 1902. It was the third Saudi state and grew into Saudi Arabia.

From exile in Kuwait, Ibn Saud captured Riyadh with a small band in 1902. Over the next years he won back Nejd from the Al Rashid of the Emirate of Jabal Shammar. In 1913 he took the eastern coast of al-Hasa from the Ottomans. In 1915 he signed a treaty with Britain, which recognised his lands.

He settled Bedouin warriors in farming colonies as the Ikhwan, zealous followers of the Wahhabi teaching, who became his shock troops. In 1921 he conquered Ha'il and took the title Sultan of Nejd. He went on to take the Hejaz in 1925, and in 1932 joined his lands as the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
sum: The Emirate of Nejd and Hasa was the state that Ibn Saud built in central Arabia after he retook Riyadh in 1902. It was the third Saudi state and grew into Saudi Arabia.
